entities.summary: Silvana Estrada (b. 1997-04-15, Coatepec Municipality) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Coatepec Municipality and Mexico. Known in the fields of mexico, composers & musicians, americas.
